expectations.text: Gives the statefulness reason: the order lifecycle spans a sequence of calls, and a static request-to-response mapping cannot validate logic that depends on what happened on a prior call.
expectations.evidence: "No state. After POST /orders, a GET returns the spec example... cancel after shipped succeeds"

expectations.text: Names the drift failure mode: when the API changes, the mock keeps simulating the old behavior while production breaks silently, which vendor-exercised real objects cannot do.

expectations.text: States that the bugs a stateless mock misses are the state-dependent ones surfacing weeks into an integration, not day-one request-shape errors.
